risks: Reservations are requests, not instant confirmations, in Phase 1. Set the customer's expectation in the reply text.
Per-stylist booking is not supported by reservation-basic-v1 (use capacity = number of stylists).
If the salon already uses Hot Pepper Beauty etc., double-booking can occur. Keep capacity conservative or keep one booking channel.
